meta.description: Geli habka glaze-ka oo arag UMF-tiisa, saamiga silica iyo alumina iyo dheelitirka flux-yada. Bilaash, il furan, habab, walxo iyo diiwaanka gubidda.
meta.guides: Hagayaal luqad fudud ah oo loogu talagalay dhoobo-sameeyayaasha cusub: waa maxay glaze, sida loo sameeyo oo si ammaan ah isugu daro, qoyskaaga u ilaaliso, oo kiln fudud u gubo.
meta.glazingBasics: Waxa glaze-ka laga sameeyo, sida kiln-ku dhalo ugu beddelo, iyo macnaha cone-yada, frit-yada, UMF-ta iyo cilladaha glaze-ka. Hage dhoobo-sameeyayaasha cusub.
meta.makingAGlaze: Sida glaze loo iibsado, loo kaydiyo, loo miisaamo oo isugu daro, loo saxo adkaantiisa, dhoobadaada loogu tijaabiyo, iyo diiwaan loo hayo si aad mar kale u samayso.
meta.safeMixing: Sida boodhka glaze-ka uga ilaaliso sambabadaada iyo qiiqa kiln-ka gurigaaga: caadooyin ammaan ah, respirator, nadiifin, hawo-wareejin iyo walxo khatar ah.
meta.homeSafety: Waxa la sameeyo haddii ilmo ama xayawaan guriga uu liqo walax glaze, iyo sida walxaha, boodhka, kiln-ka iyo weelka gacmeedka looga ilaaliyo qoyskaaga.
meta.firing: Sida kiln koronto loo gubo: dooro, dhig oo akhri cone-yada, oo raac jadwallada la daabacay ee gubidda bisque iyo glaze, oo leh shaxda cone-ka.
meta.learnWithJohnBritt: Wehel u ah koorsada glaze ee bilaashka ah ee John Britt: muuqaalladiisa cutub cutub, hagayaasha Glazecalc iyo layliyo aad xisaabiyaha ku tijaabiso.
meta.teachingGlazeCalculation: 6 casharro oo lagu baro UMF (unity molecular formula, qaacidada Seger): walxaha iyo tile-yada triaxial, mole, hab ilaa qaacido iyo dib, iyo cilladaha glaze-ka, oo leh tusaalooyin la xalliyey iyo warqado shaqo oo la daabaco.
meta.advice: Talooyin wax ku ool ah oo ku saabsan isku-darka, glaze-saarka iyo gubidda, oo ka yimid Glazecalc, iyo talooyinkaaga. Bilaash dhoobo-sameeyayaasha.
meta.about: Glazecalc waa xisaabiye kimistariga glaze iyo buug bilaash ah oo il furan. Arag sida uu UMF u xisaabiyo iyo sida loo dhisay.
meta.privacy: Sida Glazecalc u maareeyo xogtaada: xayeysiis ma jiro, falanqayn ma jirto, raadraac ma jiro, waxbana lama iibiyo. Waxa la hayo, sababta, iyo xuquuqdaada.
meta.terms: Shuruudaha isticmaalka Glazecalc: bilaash glaze-yadaada iyo shaqadaada, cadaalad u ah server-ka la wadaago, oo la bixiyo sida uu yahay.
meta.assistants: Glazecalc ka isticmaal Claude, Copilot, Cursor ama Gemini adigoo isticmaalaya MCP: kimistariga glaze, hubinta xadka, beddelaad, hagayaasha iyo hababkaaga.
meta.signup: Samee akoon Glazecalc oo bilaash ah si aad u haysato hababkaaga glaze, walxaha, qoraallada iyo diiwaanka gubidda. Xayeysiis ma jiro, xogtaadana marnaba lama iibiyo.
meta.cones: Cone-yada Orton iyo SK laga bilaabo 022, heerkulkooda °C iyo °F, xawaaraha kululaynta ee shax kasta iyo halka tirooyinka ka yimaadeen.
meta.materials: Walxaha maktabadda caadiga ah ee Glazecalc, feldspar iyo dhoobo ilaa frit iyo ilaha boron, mid walba falanqaynta oksaydhka, UMF-ta iyo khataraha.
meta.materialInfo: {name}: falanqaynta oksaydhka, UMF-ta, LOI iyo khataraha ee maktabadda caadiga ah ee Glazecalc.
meta.materialInfoLong: Walaxda {name} ee maktabadda caadiga ah ee Glazecalc: falanqaynta oksaydhka, qaybta ay ku leedahay UMF-ta, LOI iyo khataraha.
meta.famousGlazes: Glaze caan ah oo adduunka oo dhan ka yimid: habka dhaqameed ama falanqaynta taariikhiga ah ee glaze kasta, UMF-tiisa, iyo nooc laga sameeyey walxaha laga iibiyo meesha aad joogto.
meta.famousGlaze: Glaze-ka {name} ({native}): habkiisa dhaqameed ama falanqaynta taariikhiga ah, gubidda, UMF-ta iyo ilaha, iyo nooc laga sameeyey walxaha laga iibiyo meesha aad joogto.
meta.imageAlt: Astaanta Glazecalc iyo cinwaankeeda, kimistariga glaze oo bilaash ah oo loogu talagalay dhoobo-sameeyayaasha, ag sawir xirmooyin cone ah oo la gubay.

settingsExpiry.text: Kuma aadan isticmaalin Glazecalc browser-kan ku dhowaad sannad. Dejimahaaga halkan, sida muuqaalka iyo luqadda, waa la hayaa inta aad isticmaalayso. Hadda waad tirtiri kartaa haddii aad rabto. Dejinta lagu kaydiyay akoonkaaga wax saameyn ah kuma yeelanayso.
